description: Plan 9.6c acceptance (X2.7). The cart-pendulum plant is a pure bond graph: a cart 1-junction (I(M), R(b), MSe(u)) plus a point mass at the rod tip split into two translational I elements (IMx, IMv = 0.2 kg) that are coupled to the cart velocity and to the pendulum rate by MTF elements whose moduli are l*cos(theta) and l*sin(theta) (l = 0.5 m). The 0-junction HS sums v and l*cos(theta)*w into v_x; the 1-junction VJ carries v_y = -l*sin(theta)*w, I(m) and the gravity MSe(-m*g). Two FlowSensors and two Integrators reconstruct x and theta (the D28 sensor exception); the LQR is the project block library/LQR.jl with the gains from design/design.py (Q = diag(8e3, 1, 100, 10), R = 1, u = clamp(-K [x - x_ref, v, theta, w], -20, 20)). The reference values below are design.py's independent RK4 integration of the plan's non-linear equations with the same continuous controller and clamp; the bond-graph run reproduces them to ~2 % during the fast 0.1 rad recovery and the 0.2 m step, and to <0.5 % once settled (the residual is the DAE's algebraic w = (v_x - v)/(l*cos(theta)), which loses a digit when v_x and v are close).

checks.note: peak |u| = 17.86 N at the t = 1.5 s step, the design's force demand (design.py prints it); also proves |u| <= 20 N with a 10 % margin
cart position 0.2 s into the 0.1 rad recovery; the bond graph agrees with the design reference to 2 %
-3.13 deg: the tilt has crossed zero and the controller is already braking
|x| < 1 cm before the reference step: the 0.1 rad recovery has returned the cart to its origin
the tilt never exceeds the initial 0.1 rad during the recovery
0.5 mm from the origin just before the step
mid-step: the cart is half way to the 0.2 m reference after 0.5 s
the plan 9.6c band |theta| < 0.5 deg around t = 3 s (measured 0.41 deg)
cart tracking error 1.8 mm (measured 0.8 mm), i.e. |x - x_ref| < 1 cm by t = 3 s; the cart sits at the 0.2 m reference, not at the origin
the reference settles within 2 s of the step: |theta| < 0.1 deg from t = 3.5 s (measured 0.042 deg)
x = 0.1997 m at t = 3.5 s (0.26 mm from the reference)
x = 0.2000 m at the end of the run
no cart overshoot beyond 0.21 m: the 0.2 m step is approached from below

no solver failure, no causal conflict, no algebraic loop and no event-limit stop. W201 (IM, IMv in derivative causality) and W205 (Generic bond island) are expected: the point mass is over-parameterised by two translational stores plus the rigid kinematic constraint, so one store is algebraic.
